Native builds

Build the current client/server owner targets with native platform tools.

Windows x64

Use Visual Studio C++ Build Tools, LLVM clang-cl, CMake/Ninja, Python, Git, .NET 10 SDK and Slang 2026.17.1.

.\tools\build\slang-rhi.ps1
.\tools\build\windows.ps1 -Action configure
.\tools\build\windows.ps1 -Action build
.\tools\build\windows.ps1 -Action run-client

Linux

The native release bundle builds on Fedora 44 under WSL2 and passes a relocated software llvmpipe run. Hardware Vulkan remains unqualified. The Linux entrypoint uses Python and native Clang/CMake/Ninja/.NET tools. Vulkan presentation requires a working driver and the X11/XWayland surface path.

python3 tools/build/slang-rhi.py --configuration Release --jobs 8
python3 tools/build/linux.py --action configure --preset release-linux
python3 tools/build/linux.py --action build --preset release-linux --jobs 8
python3 tools/build/linux.py --action run-client --preset release-linux

Current qualification

Fresh Windows x64 checks passed 600 frames with Native AA on DX12 and Vulkan at radius 4; DX12 also passed radius 32 with 4,225 columns. All three runs reported no warnings/errors and their captures were inspected. These are rendering/UI checks, not FPS benchmarks or sustained-travel guarantees. The native Linux bundle builds on Fedora 44 under WSL2 and its fluid checks pass. A relocated Linux run passed 600 Native AA frames on software llvmpipe; hardware Vulkan remains unqualified. The experimental Fedora 44 binary requires glibc 2.43+ and GLIBCXX_3.4.35. Windows and Linux static and CPU validation aggregates both pass.
